name: Banting AI
title: Founding Commercial Lead
desc: Company Description At Banting AI, we are transforming clinical trials through intelligent automation that streamlines critical research workflows and reduces administrative burden. Our AI-powered platform helps research teams accelerate how medical breakthroughs reach patients by improving efficiency and data quality. We focus on empowering clinical research professionals so they can dedicate more time to advancing patient care and innovation. For the right person, it is a rare chance to shape a commercial team, and a category, from the very beginning.Role Description This is our first true commercial hire. You will own go-to-market in the United States, focused on bringing our solution to academic medical centers and cancer centers and growing those relationships into lasting accounts. Your job is to understand each institution’s problems deeply, build the case for change in their own numbers, and earn the trust that long, consensus-driven decisions require. You will inherit real demand and a warm pipeline. You will own the relationships you open, carrying each one from the first conversation through signature and into a lasting partnership that grows over time. From there, you will build the systems that make that success repeatable. What you’ll ownOwning the full sales cycle for enterprise deals, from the first conversation through to signature.You will work the buying group across research administration, finance, IT and security, and clinical leadership.You will move deals through the procurement, security, and legal reviews where health-system sales most often slow down.You will build a clear, buyer-specific business case for each account, grounding the value in the institution’s own numbers.QualificationsA demonstrated record of personally carrying complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS deals to signed revenue as the person accountable for the outcome.Direct experience selling into U.S. health systems, academic medical centers, cancer centers, CROs, or comparably complex regulated buyers, which we strongly prefer.Command of long, consensus-driven enterprise cycles from end to end, including stakeholder mapping, champion development, executive framing, and procurement, legal, and security review.A consultative, value-based approach to selling, with the range to move between clinical, financial, technical, and executive audiences while keeping the value you are offering clear throughout.Who you areYou read complex buying environments quickly, with a feel for how large providers make decisions, why procurement slows, and how budget cycles shape timing.You pick up new domains fast, and you are willing to become genuinely fluent in coverage analysis, ethics review, consent workflows, budgets, CTMS, and site operations.You follow through carefully and can hold many active threads at once without letting details slip.You are at home in the ambiguity of an early-stage company, and comfortable building structure while the work is already underway.Bonus pointsExisting relationships across U.S. academic medical centers, NCI-designated cancer centers, clinical trials offices.Banting AI is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

name: Baton AI
title: Founding GTM
desc: About Baton AIBaton AI (getbaton.ai) is building the enterprise automation platform for cross-application workflows. We help solutions engineering and implementation teams automate customer onboarding and product setup, turning customer requirements into executable workflows.We’re backed by Tier-1 investors, working with enterprise customers, and building toward a broader vision of AI-powered automation across enterprise software. Role DescriptionWe are hiring a Founding GTM operator to work directly with the founding team as one of our first business hires. You’ll help build the GTM engine and operating foundation for a company defining how AI automates work across enterprise software.The role starts with a clear focus on GTM: scaling pipeline, accelerating our sales motion, supporting outbound growth, sharpening customer-facing messaging, and building the systems that drive revenue. As Baton grows, your scope will expand across business operations, customer strategy, and company-building.This is a strong fit for someone who wants a steep learning curve, high ownership, and direct exposure to what it takes to build a fast-growing AI company. Key ResponsibilitiesGTM• Partner with the founding team to turn Baton’s sales motion into a repeatable GTM engine across outbound, pipeline generation, content, partnerships, and customer expansion.• Build the systems and internal tools behind that motion, using AI and automation to eliminate manual work wherever possible.• Translate customer conversations into sharper messaging, stronger sales collateral, case studies, ROI narratives, and GTM playbooks.• Keep Baton’s GTM materials sharp and up to date, including messaging, positioning, and internal sales notes.Strategic Operations• Take on high-priority projects that sit between functions: define the problem, create the plan, coordinate the right people, and drive the work to completion.• Act as a trusted extension of the founders by synthesizing context across customers, product, and sales, then turning that context into clear next steps.• Draft key communications, prep for important meetings, track decisions, and make sure follow-ups actually happen. What We’re Looking For• 2–4 years of experience in startups, consulting, finance, investing, operations, or growth.• Extremely high agency. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You identify what matters, make a plan, and drive it forward.• AI-native and automation-minded. You use AI daily, adopt new models and tools the week they ship, and build your own automations without waiting on engineering.• Sharp communicator. You can turn messy information into a simple narrative.• Analytical and detail-obsessed. You run multiple workstreams without dropping the ball.• Energized by ambiguity. You’re excited about ownership and building from zero to one.• In San Francisco. Excited to work in person with us. Nice to Have• Experience at an early-stage B2B SaaS or AI company.• Exposure to solutions engineering, implementation, professional services, or enterprise software.• Experience with outbound, partnerships, events, content, or founder-led sales. Why Join Us• Founding-team impact. Help define our GTM motion, operating systems, and culture from the ground up.• Real ownership early. Take on meaningful scope and a direct line to the founders from day one.• Competitive pay and early equity. Be rewarded for the value you create as we grow.• A front-row seat to company-building. We're a Y Combinator-backed startup (S25) based in New York City, and we're growing fast. You'll be the one turning that story into signed agencies across the country.The TeamBrian is a former EMT who saw firsthand how much time paramedics waste on paperwork — he started CareSwift to give them back hours of their day. We're a small, tight-knit founding team that moves fast and cares deeply about the EMS community.About The RoleUntil now, every CareSwift deal has been sourced, run, and closed by our founder. As our Founding Account Executive, you'll take over the full sales cycle — prospecting, discovery, demos, pilots, procurement, and signature — and turn what's working into a repeatable playbook.This is not a book-meetings-and-hand-off role. name: City Flavor
title: Founding Account Executive (Sales / GTM / Outbound)
desc: About City FlavorCity Flavor builds and runs food programs at some of the most demanding corporate campuses in the country. We connect local food trucks, caterers, and pop-ups to leading technology manufacturers, aerospace companies, top universities, and national research institutions, and we handle the scheduling, compliance, payments, and technology that make these programs run. Since January 2024 we've managed 65,000+ food shifts at a 99.97% fill rate and generated $80M+ for our vendor partners. We're profitable, growing, and now ready to build sales the right way.About This RoleThis is a foundational sales hire and a fresh start for how we build our go-to-market. We've sold successfully before, but we've never had a dedicated, repeatable outbound engine, and that's what this role is here to create. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with me (the CEO) to define our playbook, open new accounts, and turn a strong reputation with a handful of marquee clients into a growing book of business.If you want a polished machine with leads handed to you, this isn't it. If you want to build the machine, keep reading.What You'll DoYou'll own outbound from first touch to closed deal. That means identifying target campuses and decision makers, running the prospecting yourself, getting meetings, and working alongside me to present, negotiate, and close. Early on we'll be in the weeds together figuring out what works, then systematizing it.A core part of this job is building AI-powered outbound. We expect you to use AI tools and automations to research accounts, draft and personalize outreach at scale, manage follow-up sequences, and keep our pipeline moving without an army of SDRs. This is not a "nice to have." If you can't or won't work this way, you won't be a fit.You'll also stay close to our operations team so that everything you sell actually launches well and grows, because in this business the first program is the start of the relationship, not the end.Who You AreYou have a few years of new-business experience and you've carried a closing quota, ideally selling into mid-market and enterprise. You're genuinely a hunter who likes opening cold doors more than managing warm ones. You're fluent with AI tools and automation and you reach for them by default. You're comfortable with ambiguity and the reality that an early-stage playbook gets rewritten often. You're organized enough to run your own pipeline in a CRM without being told. And you care about the product, local food, great vendors, and a workplace perk people actually look forward to.Why This RoleYou'll work directly with the founder, not three layers down. You'll have real influence over how we sell and what we build. You'll sell something concrete with proof behind it, not vapor. And you'll get in early at a profitable, growing company where the upside of building the function is yours to capture.CompensationThe base salary range for this role is $90,000-$110,000 and includes a sales bonus plan that is paid monthly and tied to metrics and results. The base salary is dependent on a number of factors, including but not limited to work experience, training, location, and skills. Health benefits and 401K included.

desc: About The RoleThis is the first dedicated sales hire at a fast-growing, seed-stage B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered platform for value intelligence — helping enterprise and mid-market sales teams create rigorous, data-driven business cases and measure ROI across the full customer lifecycle. The company has closed dozens of enterprise customers with zero churn through founder-led sales, and is now ready to transition that motion into a repeatable, scalable function.As the Founding Account Executive, you will own the mid-market sales motion end-to-end: sourcing your own pipeline, running full-cycle deals, and closing independently. The CEO will continue to lead larger strategic accounts and co-sell on select enterprise deals — but mid-market is yours to build and scale. This is the most critical go-to-market hire the company is making right now, and it comes with meaningful equity.What You'll DoBuild your own pipeline. There is no SDR team. You'll develop a repeatable outbound motion targeting the ICP — Series C–E SaaS companies with emerging or scaling value engineering functions. Prospecting, networking, events, and creative channel plays are all part of your toolkit. If you need leads handed to you, this role isn't the right fit. Run full-cycle mid-market deals. Own every stage from first meeting through signed contract — including discovery, multi-threading across buying committees of 5–10 stakeholders, positioning with economic buyers (typically CROs), navigating procurement, and closing. Engage sophisticated buyers. Your primary personas are Heads of Value Engineering, VPs of Sales, and CROs at scaling B2B SaaS companies. These buyers know what great selling looks like and will expect you to have done this work yourself. Partner on expansion. Stay involved post-close alongside the Implementation Lead to identify and drive upsell and expansion opportunities. You're incentivized on expansion revenue. Build the playbook. As the first AE, you'll help define and document the repeatable sales motion — messaging, objection handling, deal stages, and qualification criteria — that future hires will build on.
